ruleset.name: Phlix-Console-Tests-PSR12
ruleset.description:
PSR-12 for tests/ — the phpcs gate for the CI "Run PHPCS on tests/" step. Modeled on phlix-server's phpcs-tests.xml (same doctrine: exclusions must be measured, classified, and justified; warnings are reported but do not block; the gate is phpcs's nonzero exit code, never a grep of report prose).
THE MEASUREMENT THAT SHAPED THIS FILE (phlix-console-client @ 7a1763c, phpcs 4.0.4, `--standard=PSR12 tests/`):
A TOTAL OF 25 ERRORS AND 460 WARNINGS WERE FOUND IN 75 FILES
PSR12.Files.FileHeader.IncorrectOrder ......... 11 (FIXED: file-level docblock moved above declare(strict_types=1);, scripted swap, line-multiset-identical — comments moved, nothing rewritten) Squiz.WhiteSpace.ScopeClosingBrace ............ 12 (FIXED by phpcbf: inline empty closures `function (): void {}` split across lines, whitespace-only) PSR1.Classes.ClassDeclaration.MultipleClasses .. 2 (EXCLUDED below) Generic.Files.LineLength ..................... 460 (warnings, kept visible and non-blocking via ignore_warnings_on_exit)
Console test methods are camelCase already (zero PSR1.Methods.CamelCapsMethodName violations), so unlike phlix-server there is no method-name exclusion here.
1. PSR1.Classes.ClassDeclaration.MultipleClasses — 2 errors, both in tests/AppTest.php: the recording doubles SpyTeardownScreen and SlashCapturingScreen live beside their only consumer, out of any autoloadable namespace, exactly the pattern phlix-server's S128 gate carves out for test code. Splitting doubles into files of their own makes the suite harder to read, not more correct. src/ is unaffected: the src gate (phpcs.xml) enforces zero exclusions and all six src MultipleClasses errors were split into PSR-4 files instead.
WARNINGS ARE REPORTED AND DO NOT BLOCK — and the difference from `-n` matters. phpcs exits non-zero on WARNINGS ALONE, so a gate that trusts its exit code would be permanently red over 460 pre-existing long-line warnings, and the next person would silence the whole step. So ignore_warnings_on_exit below changes only the exit code: every warning is still counted and printed in the job log. Do NOT add `-n`, do NOT exclude Generic.Files.LineLength, do NOT add `|| true` to the CI step.
